root.say: Hello. I am HARVI, your Holographic Autonomous Response and Virtual Intelligence. What shall we explore?

tour.say: This city is generated from your own PC. Every building is a folder, every tower a drive. Fly with W A S D, look with the mouse, hold Shift to go faster.

windows.say: Apps open as floating glass windows. Click one to focus it, drag its title bar to move it, and F8 cycles the arrangement. Alt+Tab switches between them.

car.say: Press F10 to summon the car from anywhere. C changes camera, Space is the handbrake, Shift boosts. The track fades in while you drive.

controls.say: F1 summons me. F2 opens the command ring, F7 the on-screen keyboard, F9 toggles the city, F10 the car, F12 takes a screenshot. V toggles VR.

trouble.say: Tell me what is wrong. Is the picture too foggy or too bright, is the sound off, or is a window lost?

fog_fix.say: I have opened the fog controls. Lower density and brightness for clearer streets; raise clarity to see the floors from above.

light_fix.say: Here are the graphics options. The lighting sliders shape how bright the neon feels.

sound_fix.say: Check the sound effects slider on this page. If it is still silent, check your Windows output device.

lost_fix.say: I rearranged your windows so they should all be in front of you again.

settings_ok.say: Settings are open. Everything saves automatically, and the FOG page has a reset button if you get lost.

media_ok.say: The media player is open. Add folders in settings and it will build a library with posters, cast and lyrics.

ctx_settings.say: You are in Settings. Sliders change instantly. Need a hand with the fog or lighting?

ctx_media.say: The media library fetches posters, cast, storylines and lyrics in the background and remembers them. Click a poster to open it.

ctx_browser.say: This is the web browser. Ctrl+L focuses the address bar and F3 changes how deep the page is drawn.

ctx_files.say: The file browser works like the city: double click a folder to go in, drag to move files, and the right-click menu has the rest.

ctx_car.say: Nice wheels. Hold Shift to boost, Space to drift, and C to change view. Press F10 again to get out.

tips: Press F9 to switch between the city and the file room at any time.
Drag a folder onto the shell to add it to your media library.
The command ring on F2 holds shortcuts to every tool.
Right click a window to pin your view to it, and again to let go.
The fog sliders live in Settings, and RESET FOG returns them to normal.
The speedometer appears whenever you are driving the car.
Ctrl and Tab work like a task switcher between your open windows.
